execution_surface: native parent synthesis of cited independent role execution and/or actual controlled tests
evidence_maturity: observed analysis output; distinguish proposed interventions inside detail
operation: Ran residuality audit and the local evidence-drift trial.
result: Six stressors mapped to residues and observable requirements; attractors are provenance loss, coordination dependence, and workflow overreach. Evidence-only drift was missed by the narrow list and caught by the full contract.

stressors.stressor: A helper or preferred skill becomes unavailable during a route.
stressors.provenance: credible proposed stressor from multi-step dependencies; no outage observed
stressors.incumbent_degradation: The parent cannot honestly claim all joined concerns completed.
stressors.alternative_degradation: A single investigator can continue reading available evidence but loses independent coverage.
stressors.desired_residue: Frozen sources, completed concern findings, explicit missing coverage, and a bounded next action.
stressors.spec_implication: Record partial join status, preserve evidence artifacts, allow an explicit reduced-coverage branch only if fixed obligations still hold.
stressors.test: Inspect the completion record with one missing concern; it must report incomplete coverage rather than fabricate synthesis.

stressors.stressor: Reviewers equate agreement among agents with independent evidence.
stressors.provenance: proposed failure mode explicitly named by S03
stressors.incumbent_degradation: Several voices can amplify the same source omission.
stressors.alternative_degradation: One causal record makes shared provenance visible but can miss an independent concern.
stressors.desired_residue: Claims linked to source provenance and shared-source dependencies; minority concerns preserved.
stressors.spec_implication: Treat agent outputs as independent reasoning, not independent empirical samples; group claims by underlying observation.
stressors.test: Present three reports from one source and one contrary observation; source count must not become a vote.

stressors.stressor: No decision owner has capacity to resolve every remaining gap.
stressors.provenance: credible proposed stressor from explicit per-claim residue/owner and operating effort obligations; no actual unavailable owner observed
stressors.incumbent_degradation: A detailed residue ledger can become an unowned queue despite artifact completion.
stressors.alternative_degradation: A bounded decision rule reduces repeated escalation but can leave novel cases undecidable.
stressors.desired_residue: One ranked evidence request per decision, explicit decision rights, review trigger, and unadopted candidates retained.
stressors.spec_implication: Do not count an owner label as accepted operational capacity; distinguish research ownership from eventual adoption authority.
stressors.recovery_owner: user for operational adoption; parent for research triage
stressors.test: Remove an assumed owner from a candidate and require either an authorized fallback or an unresolved verdict.

stressors.stressor: A step artifact presents a hypothesis as an observed result.
stressors.provenance: observed contract ambiguity in EO-F1; runtime error is a proposed stressor
stressors.incumbent_degradation: Shape checks can pass while causal support is overstated.
stressors.alternative_degradation: A compact card can suffer the same error if it lacks provenance.
stressors.desired_residue: Typed prediction, observation, inference, source, and limitation fields.
stressors.spec_implication: Provenance typing is shared by every candidate method; it cannot be claimed as an advantage merely because a route names a validator.
stressors.test: Change only evidence class from hypothetical to observed; require a supporting trace or reject the promotion.

stressors.stressor: The compared records disagree only on evidence provenance.
stressors.provenance: actual checklist omission EO-F2 supports a controlled mutation test
stressors.incumbent_degradation: A four-field equality implementation could miss the mismatch.
stressors.alternative_degradation: Human comparison can miss it too without an obligation checklist.
stressors.desired_residue: An explicit evidence mismatch and the field owner's reconciliation.
stressors.spec_implication: Evaluate every obligation in the pass gate, including evidence, not only the local enumerated fields.
stressors.test: Hold listed fields constant and swap a source-backed claim for an invented one; the pair must fail.

stressors.stressor: The one-time strategy research suite becomes mandatory for routine small changes.
stressors.provenance: proposed stressor explicitly anticipated by S14, not observed adoption
stressors.incumbent_degradation: Coordination effort can exceed the unresolved uncertainty.
stressors.alternative_degradation: A direct route can underinvestigate when a new contradiction appears.
stressors.desired_residue: A named adequacy check, successful direct exit, and escalation trigger.
stressors.spec_implication: Every operational use starts by checking uncertainty and coverage; the explicit research request still requires all sixteen strategy runs.
stressors.test: Use the actual field-membership question in method_fit; exit directly, then contrast a causal-efficacy question that the same inspection cannot resolve.

detail.classification: audit plus one controlled evidence stress test
